audit.description: Changed production code in frontmatter/default_handlers.py imports tomli and calls tomli.loads in TOMLHandler.load, which is meaningful runtime use of the target API. The diff removes the direct toml import and toml.loads/toml.dumps references from changed production code, and dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from production repo. The target origin is a site-packages tomli shared object and target_local_spec_count is 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake tomli provider.
evidence: frontmatter/default_handlers.py: import toml replaced with import tomli; ImportError branch now sets tomli = None
frontmatter/default_handlers.py: TOMLHandler.load asserts tomli is not None and returns tomli.loads(fm, **kwargs)
frontmatter/default_handlers.py: __all__ and class gating changed from if toml to if tomli
Dynamic metrics: tomli origin is after_venv_overlay/.../site-packages/tomli/__init__.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so with target_local_spec_count = 0
reasons: Production code imports and uses tomli.loads
No changed production code imports or accesses toml
Dynamic audit shows target events from production repo and no source imports from production repo
No local target provider or shim detected
